image5.1: Four adharmas occupy ten percent of human beings, while religion occupies 99 percent.
image5.2: While Yagna, Dana (donation), Veda, and Tapas (prolonged meditation) are the four adharmas, the fifth adharma is religion.
image5.3: The biggest obstacle to the divine path is religion.
image5.4: Religion is the biggest of all adharmas.
image5.5: If you are in religion in the worldly path, you will be killed in God's path.
image5.7: Religion is the fifth adharma to emerge in the Kali Yuga newly.

image6.1: Religions are forbidden and prohibited. Castes are irrational and unscientific.
image6.2: The Bhagavad Gita, the Bible and the Quran
image6.3: are all three parts of the same divine scripture. If your attitude transcends beyond caste and religion, immediately join
image6.5: as a member. I want God to make you gnani.
image6.6: The only Guru of Three Religions and the Originator of Thraitha Theorem
